name: Academy of Military Science
zh: 中国人民解放军军事科学院

evidence.summary: The Academy of Military Science is the PLA’s main military research academy: Xinhua describes it as an important PLA research institution, and it reports directly to the Central Military Commission. It writes the internal guidelines for how China’s forces are employed, and in 2017 it absorbed research institutes from the PLA’s former general departments, including its military medicine and defence science and technology innovation institutes.
The Academy of Military Science reports directly to the Central Military Commission.
